title: DirectoryListing
description: `GET /workspaces/directories`: one level of one directory, never the tree (plan 06, D-05).

parent.description: `null` at the root: the picker never climbs above it.

path.description: Absolute path of the entry as listed — for a symlink, the link, not its target.

hidden.description: The name starts with `.`. Listed only when `hidden=true` was asked.

symlink.description: A symlink whose target is a directory inside the same root. One that escapes is omitted.

truncated.description: The ceiling cut the listing; `prefix` reaches what was left out.
